entry.title: Advancing computer use with Ironclad
entry.summary:
OpenAI and Ironclad are collaborating to train and evaluate AI agents on complex legal contracting workflows to improve computer use capabilities for professional tasks.

Why it matters: Developing AI agents on domain-specific contracting tasks helps improve automated computer-use capabilities for specialized professional environments.

entry.title: llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0
entry.summary:
Simon Willison released llm-openai-decisions 0.1a0, an LLM CLI plugin supporting OpenAI's new Decisions API and gpt-6-luna model.

Why it matters: It enables CLI users to run low-cost, structured decision and classification queries on text and images using OpenAI's gpt-6-luna model.

entry.title: llm-mistral 0.16
entry.summary:
Version 0.16 of the llm-mistral plugin adds support for reasoning models, including Mistral Large 4.

Why it matters: Users of the llm CLI tool can now leverage Mistral's latest reasoning models, including Mistral Large 4.

entry.title: Mistral Large 4
entry.summary:
Simon Willison tested Mistral Large 4 alongside Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6.1-Sol, and Gemini 3.8-Flash by generating SVG images for an absurd prompt derived from a Hacker News comment.

Why it matters: Visualizing complex, absurd SVG prompts serves as an informal benchmark for testing spatial rendering and instruction-following capabilities across different LLMs.
